mapper.select: SELECT a.`id` AS "id", a.`map_name` AS "mapName", a.`project_id` AS "projectId", a.`map_size` AS "mapSize", a.`scale` AS "scale", a.`file_path` AS "filePath", a.`status` AS "status", a.`create_by` AS "createBy", a.`create_date` AS "createDate", a.`update_by` AS "updateBy", a.`update_date` AS "updateDate", a.`remarks` AS "remarks" FROM `swm_site_map_management` a WHERE a.`status` = '0' ORDER BY a.`update_date` DESC LIMIT 1
